The '''Dreighton Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]], [[Dreighton]], and [[Imdaar/Legends|Imdaar]], as well as the [[Arah asteroid belt|Belt of Arah]].

==History==
The [[Battle of Dreighton]] was fought in the nebula during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Dreighton Nebula had taken on a myth of its own. Avoided by the superstitious, the Nebula was believed to be a graveyard for ships; pilots who entered the Nebula or the [[Dreighton Triangle]] therein were believed never to return.

{{Neb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] incorrectly places the planet [[Rhand]] in the Dreighton Nebula, instead of the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]].<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
